mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule (user_id, kind, start_at, end_at, start_date, end_date, title) VALUES (#{userId}, #{kind}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{title})
mapper.update: UPDATE schedule SET kind = #{kind}, start_at = #{startAt}, end_at = #{endAt}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, title = #{title} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM schedule WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.schedule_id, c.color, c.memo, s.kind, s.start_at, s.end_at, s.start_date, s.end_date, s.title FROM calendar_event c INNER JOIN schedule s ON c.schedule_id = s.id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId}
